(def -indexOf
  (fn ([coll x]
   (-indexOf coll x 0))
  ([coll x start]
   (let [len (count coll)]
     (if (>= start len)
       -1
       (loop [idx (cond
                    (pos? start) start
                    (neg? start) (let [candidate (+ start len)] (if (> 0 candidate) 0 candidate))
                    :else start)]
         (if (< idx len)
           (if (= (nth coll idx) x)
             idx
             (recur (inc idx)))
           -1)))))))
